_comment: A sample plugin hub index. Copy this to index.json in the DeathPlateau-Plugins repo (or
wherever you point -Dlostcity.pluginindex at) and fill in your own plugins.
id       required. The jar is installed as <id>.jar, so it may only be letters, digits,
dash and underscore. Never change one after release: it is how the client knows
an installed plugin is this plugin.
name     required. What the hub shows.
url      required. http or https. Where the jar is.
version  compared as text. A different string to the installed one offers an update.
sha256   strongly recommended. Checked after download; a mismatch throws the file away.
Get it with: sha256sum plugin.jar   (Windows: certutil -hashfile plugin.jar SHA256)
author, description  shown in the hub.
Keys starting with _ are ignored, which is what makes this comment legal JSON.

plugins.name: Coordinates
plugins.description: Shows your world position in the corner of the viewport
plugins.author: Corey

plugins.name: XP tracker
plugins.description: Session experience and xp/hr. F7 resets it.
plugins.author: Corey
